rationale: Coconut oil applied to vulva with vaginal Replens for breast-cancer survivors' genitourinary syndrome; DIVA quality-of-life and sexual function, terminated with no posted results. Not oral virgin oil or an isolated urinary-urgency assessment.

Thermogenic supplement and structured exercise versus placebo and exercise in adults with metabolic risk; description discusses phenylcapsaicin analogue, with 6-minute walking and timed up-and-go planned. Product ingredient identity is not explicitly specified in arm fields; no posted results and no ground cayenne.

Acute ischemic stroke randomized capsaicin transmucosal oral film vs placebo with 72-hour adverse events and blood-pressure/heart-rate outcomes; not black pepper or piperine, no Parkinson drooling comparison.

Intramuscular testosterone versus intramuscular sesame oil in critically ill patients; ventilator-free days primary, timed up-and-go and other mobility secondary. Sesame is injected, not oral cold-pressed oil; no posted results.

HIV-related weight loss testosterone enanthate versus placebo with stair climbing, walking speed and load carry. Official intervention fields do not specify sesame oil; no demonstrated edible sesame exposure or Parkinson comparison.

Spinal-cord injury testosterone plus finasteride versus placebo, weekly injections and daily pills; bone density and walking speed outcomes, posted results. Official arm fields do not identify an oral sesame intervention.
Cinnamon herbal patch vs placebo patch in overactive bladder; OAB symptom score, urgency severity and patient perception listed. Topical patch is not ingested ground cinnamon; no posted results.

Oral vitamin D emulsion lists sesame oil as vehicle; placebo comparator, 6-month gait velocity, step length and other physical tests secondary. Oil dose and cold-pressed grade unspecified, vitamin D effect cannot be attributed to carrier; no posted results.

Dispepril standardized ginger plus Perilla frutescens extract, alone or with proton-pump inhibitor, versus full-dose PPI. Official title and all outcomes specify functional dyspepsia and gastrointestinal symptoms, while condition field says functional dysphonia; no vocal-intensity measure or results. Perilla plant part and dried culinary preparation unverified.

Acute Nepalese pepper Zanthoxylum armatum extract vs placebo and caffeine in gamers; cognitive fatigue and finger tapping planned, no Piper nigrum intervention or Parkinson dexterity test. Registry lists completed, no posted results.

Pleurotus oyster mushroom soup dose study has common pepper and other seasonings in all arms, with finger tapping and cognitive outcomes; pepper species, exposure contrast and any separate piperine dose not established, no posted results.

Nepalese pepper Zanthoxylum armatum extract versus placebo for 42 days in gamers; subjective cognitive fatigue and finger tapping planned, not Piper nigrum or Parkinson disease. Not yet recruiting and no posted results.
